entities.name: Alpharael
entities.description: A young Monoist acolyte from Susur Secundi who follows his sister toward the Plummet, joins a boarding party against the Dawnsire, kills no knight but throws away his sekhar to live, and is spared by Captain Slats.

entities.name: Raphaella
entities.description: Alpharael's sister, chosen by the monastery for the Plummet; he fears she may be burning on the edge of Sothera.

entities.name: Simma
entities.description: An old Monoist miracho (a deleter or killer) in the boarding party who fights dirty and attacks Syr Vondam.

entities.name: Nagashua
entities.description: A Monoist boarder whose best friend, a mechan, has forgotten her; she is killed by a Sunstar foot soldier in the fighting.

entities.name: Zagachoir
entities.description: A cheerful Monoist boarder who is mortally wounded by cnidomines and has Alpharael help him take sekhar.

entities.name: Purael
entities.description: A hard Monoist murderer in the boarding party who believes the Next Eternity has been filled with castoffs and means to enforce discipline there.

entities.name: Haliya
entities.description: A squire of the Sunstar Free Company who serves Syr Vondam, wields a bladiator, and has a gift she can broadcast to protect her knight.

entities.name: Syr Vondam
entities.description: A Solar Knight of the Sunstar Free Company prophesied to die; a tiny black hole passes through his head yet he survives.

entities.name: Syr Walker
entities.description: A knight of the Sunstar Free Company who fights alongside Vondam and later secures the nearest inevitor.

entities.name: Quinidad
entities.description: A squire who serves Syr Walker and makes tactical reports during the boarding fight.

entities.name: Slats
entities.description: An Astelli captain of the Dawnsire and coronal of the faithful aboard, who foresaw Vondam's death and Alpharael, and spares the latter.

entities.name: Dawnsire
entities.description: A vast javelin-shaped Sunstar ship carrying a horizon javelin that can unmake a supervoid into a star, and two laser batteries called Nacho and Nacha.

entities.name: Horizon javelin
entities.description: The mechanism at the Dawnsire's heart that undoes a supervoid into a star.

entities.name: Nacho and Nacha
entities.description: A pair of Ignacio free-electron lasers at the Dawnsire's prow, used to harvest power from supervoids and as weapons; they bombard Susur Secundi.

entities.name: Hopelight warmaker
entities.description: An Astelli fighter craft on the Dawnsire's flight deck that Alpharael is allowed to take and escape in.

entities.name: Sothera
entities.description: The star system where the war takes place, said to hold the Next Eternity and claimed by Drix, Monoists and Sunstar alike.

entities.name: Susur Secundi
entities.description: A Monoist monastery-world, home of Alpharael, with a monastery in construction above it that the Dawnsire strikes.

entities.name: Monoism
entities.description: The faith of Susur Secundi that believes all mass will collapse into black holes, and that those who take sekhar join the Next Eternity.

entities.name: Sunstar Free Company
entities.description: The Sunstar faith's fighting order, crewing the Dawnsire with knights, squires and foot soldiers, devoted to growing the Sum.

entities.name: Astelli
entities.description: A luminous species of quantum-probabilistic angels, twin to the Susurians who founded the True Faith, aligned with the Sunstar side.

entities.name: Drix
entities.description: Rivals whom the page's narrator says will take the narrator if Alpharael dies.

entities.name: Pinnacle
entities.description: The host of the Drix in Sothera.

entities.name: The Faller
entities.description: The deity of Monoism, who plummets, and to whom the faithful cry praise.

entities.name: Next Eternity
entities.description: The Monoist paradise reached by taking sekhar.

entities.name: Sekhar
entities.description: The Monoist rite of releasing a singularity bead from one's armor so the wearer collapses into the Next Eternity.

entities.name: Cherazad
entities.description: A cyst of altered space an inevitor deploys on impact, trapping the collision on its horizon for about ten minutes.

entities.name: Anstruth
entities.description: A blasphemy against reality: an event made inevitable by engineering, which Vondam fears applies to him.

entities.name: The Sum
entities.description: The Sunstar principle of life and light that is to be grown, opposed to the Monoist claim that it will reduce to zero.

events.summary: Inside an inevitor, Alpharael learns the names of his fellow boarders, all Monoists bound for paradise.
events.quote: After he finishes screaming, Alpharael learns a few names.

events.summary: Alpharael insists his sister Raphaella, chosen for the Plummet, is no heretic.
events.quote: "My sister's not a heretic," Alpharael protests.

events.summary: The Monoists recite the prayer of gravity together.
events.quote: "This is the grace of gravity," someone says.

events.summary: The inevitor strikes the Dawnsire and deploys a cherazad that suspends most of the impact.
events.quote: As it strikes the Dawnsire , the inevitor deploys a cyst of altered space, a tactical event horizon: a cherazad.

events.summary: Anti-armor mines hit Zagachoir and ricochet inside his armor and body.
events.quote: Every cnidomine in the compartment hits Zagachoir.

events.summary: The boarding party leaps for the inner hull toward the Sunstar defenders.
events.quote: Everyone casts their center of mass forward.

events.summary: Zagachoir, spinning and bleeding, asks Alpharael to help him take sekhar.
events.quote: "I want to take sekhar now."

events.summary: Alpharael crushes Zagachoir's singularity bead housing, sending him into the Next Eternity.
events.quote: Alpharael crushes the singularity bead's housing and kicks free.

events.summary: Zagachoir collapses into a violet pinprick that falls out through the hull.
events.quote: Zagachoir collapses into a violet pinprick, eaten by the uncaged void.

events.summary: A Sunstar foot soldier blinds Nagashua with a bladiator flash and kills her.
events.quote: He thrusts the bladiator through her heart.

events.summary: The Monoist boarders overwhelm the Sunstar defenders in a short fight.
events.quote: Then, it is over. Alpharael barely got to swing his axe.

events.summary: A puzzler takes sekhar and the resulting microvoid pierces the inner hull, letting the boarders open a hatch.
events.quote: One of the puzzlers bellows, "Praise HIM !" and takes sekhar.

events.summary: Behind the hatch the boarders find a Sunstar basilica and someone begins burning it.
events.quote: It's a basilica, a house of the Sunstar faith.

events.summary: Purael orders the mission to continue, with the puzzle club going downship to find the blasphemy mechanisms.
events.quote: Puzzle club downship.

events.summary: Alpharael volunteers to go with Simma to kill a Solar Knight and is shot.
events.quote: "I'm coming with you!" Alpharael says.

events.summary: Squire Haliya follows Syr Vondam down the Dawnsire's spine, convinced she will die.
events.quote: They plunge down the Dawnsire 's spine.

events.summary: Haliya fears for Vondam, who is prophesied to die, and resolves to die before him.
events.quote: Vondam is prophesied to die.

events.summary: Vondam, Walker and Quinidad learn from a phonon survey that Sunstar garrison troops are fighting the boarders near the basilica.
events.quote: A company of the garrison has engaged boarders just abeam of the basilica.

events.summary: Vondam and Walker fire their bladiators through the deck to strike the Monoists below, with Haliya cleaning Vondam's beamline.
events.quote: The two knights plunge their bladiators into the deck and fire .

events.summary: The Monoists below pulse gravity waves at the deck, shaking it apart.
events.quote: The deck whines under their boots.

events.summary: The deck collapses under Haliya.
events.quote: The deck goes out from under her.

events.summary: As she falls, Haliya broadcasts all her power to protect Vondam.
events.quote: She throws her arms out to her knight and broadcasts every bit of power she can.

events.summary: Haliya blasts her way out of a flooded bathhouse tank with a bladiator steam jet.
events.quote: The steam jet cuts through the soft wall of the water tank, and the boiling water blasts her out like a cork into the bathhouse floor.

events.summary: Haliya fires at a Monoist fanatic gliding toward her.
events.quote: Haliya snaps her bladiator up and fires.

events.summary: Beams cut through the ceiling at Alpharael, but a thrown jar of aeromuck saves him from being killed.
events.quote: Two beams through the ceiling skewer Alpharael.

events.summary: Simma pulls on space and drops a collapsing structure on the enemy, buying minutes.
events.quote: Far above her, something rumbles and comes down like an avalanche.

events.summary: Alpharael bellows a challenge to the Sunstar defenders as bait for Simma's plan.
events.quote: I am Alpharael of Secundi, and against me, your armor is—cracked leather!

events.summary: In the bathhouse Alpharael is shot by a seemingly dead Summist, who is Haliya.
events.quote: The dead Summist shoots him.

events.summary: Alpharael's tidal attack backfires and hits his own armor.
events.quote: He has shot himself in the face.

events.summary: A Monoist fanatic seizes Haliya's helmet and concusses her at ninety-five gravities.
events.quote: The concussion blanks her.

events.summary: Alpharael, thinking of his lost sister, pins Haliya and attacks her head.
events.quote: So Alpharael bears down on the fallen Summist and rattles her brain in her skull like a bruised pomegranate.

events.summary: Haliya's blade splits Alpharael open and his armor fails, and a Sunstar knight's beam throws him into a corner.
events.quote: The Summist's blade splits him open.

events.summary: Vondam arrives, drives Alpharael off Haliya, and orders a concussion drill.
events.quote: Haliya! Concussion drill!

events.summary: Vondam accepts Alpharael's challenge, naming himself of the Sunstar Free Company.
events.quote: I am Syr Vondam of the Sunstar Free Company.

events.summary: Simma pounces from the steam to slap a mine on Vondam's helm.
events.quote: Old Simma pounces.

events.summary: Vondam blasts Simma off course with a pulse of sunfire.
events.quote: The knight twists the pulse of sunfire down a magnetic field and blasts Simma askew.

events.summary: Vondam kills the main enemy, apparently Simma, and Haliya fights to hold Alpharael back.
events.quote: Vondam has killed the main enemy.

events.summary: Vondam offers the now unarmored Alpharael mercy, urging him to choose life.
events.quote: Come, then! Choose life!

events.summary: Alpharael throws away his singularity bead, giving up his sekhar to kill his foe.
events.quote: He has thrown away his sekhar.

events.summary: The newborn microvoid passes through Syr Vondam's head.
events.quote: Along the way, it goes directly through Syr Vondam's head .

events.summary: Alpharael has chosen life over immortality and cannot escape.
events.quote: Alpharael chose to live.

events.summary: Alpharael watches in disbelief as Vondam topples and decides to flee.
events.quote: Alpharael stares in giddy disbelief as Syr Vondam, Solar Knight of the Free Company, topples like a drunk.

events.summary: Fleeing, Alpharael runs into another Solar Knight, who captures him with a microwave field.
events.quote: He slams face-first into another Solar Knight.

events.summary: Alpharael meets Captain Slats, an Astelli, inside a light.
events.quote: My name is Slats. I'm the captain of this instrument, and the coronal of the faithful aboard.

events.summary: Slats tells Alpharael he foresaw him killing his friend and asks why.
events.quote: You struck dead a man who was my friend. I foresaw this. I want to know why.

events.summary: Slats sentences Alpharael to live.
events.quote: I sentence you to live.

events.summary: Slats directs Alpharael to a flight deck and a Hopelight warmaker, saying the Dawnsire is turning on Susur Secundi.
events.quote: You will find a Hopelight warmaker waiting for you.

events.summary: Alpharael scrambles to the flight deck with one hand.
events.quote: It takes him two of his remaining minutes to scramble down a spiraling emergency ramp to a flight deck.

events.summary: A warmaker admits Alpharael and he forces an emergency launch despite the daycode problem.
events.quote: "Captain's compliments," the fighter says.

events.summary: The warmaker drops down the Dawnsire's flight rail while Alpharael is vitrified by hardlight.
events.quote: A hardlight field seizes every atom in Alpharael's body and converts him, very briefly, into a uniform crystal.

events.summary: Haliya despairs over Vondam's apparent death and her failure to save him.
events.quote: The Haliya who wasn't quick, or strong, or sure enough to save her knight, the Haliya who allowed a pathetic fallen foe to throw his suicide through Vondam's skull .

events.summary: Vondam is revealed alive, with a pinhead hole through his head.
events.quote: He shows Haliya the hole in his helmet, then the hole in his face, just to the left of his nose.

events.summary: Slats says Vondam died but was not dead.
events.quote: You died, but you were not dead.

events.summary: Haliya reveals that Captain Slats let Alpharael escape in a Hopelight.
events.quote: "Captain Slats let him."

events.summary: Slats announces retaliation against Susur Secundi after the three inevitors are defeated.
events.quote: By my authority as coronal of this ship, I have ordered retaliation against Susur Secundi.

events.summary: Vondam suspects the event of his survival was engineered and that he is an anstruth.
events.quote: I am also an anstruth.

events.summary: Vondam concludes some force wants Alpharael alive.
events.quote: I'm saying that something wants that Monoist alive.

events.summary: Vondam vows that he and Haliya will pursue Alpharael once healed.
events.quote: But once we're fit again, we're going after him.

events.summary: The narrator explains the horizon javelin at the Dawnsire's heart.
events.quote: The mechanism that undoes a supervoid into a star is in fact called a horizon javelin.

events.summary: Nacha fires a laser pulse train across two hundred lightseconds at Susur Secundi.
events.quote: Nacha fires.

events.summary: Nacho maps the defenses from Nacha's shot and then hits the monastery being built above Susur Secundi.
events.quote: The monastery in construction above Susur Secundi jets violet plasma and lurches in its orbit.

events.summary: Alpharael's warmaker burns away from the Dawnsire, unremarked by anyone.
events.quote: And if any of those eyes take note of the Hopelight warmaker burning furiously away from the Dawnsire , headed anywhere but home—they do not say.

relations.note: Alpharael's sister, chosen for the Plummet.
relations.quote: "My sister's not a heretic," Alpharael protests.

relations.note: Purael is one of the True Faith heading to the Next Eternity.
relations.quote: so she is going ahead to paradise to enforce discipline and make sure it is ready for the rest of the True Faith to arrive.

relations.note: Zagachoir comforts Alpharael and asks him for help taking sekhar.
The Monoists board the Dawnsire to destroy its weapon and fight the Sunstar soldiers.
relations.quote: Monoists like to swarm over them in cover and tear them apart.

relations.note: Quinidad is Walker's squire and fights beside him.
Vondam names himself of the Free Company.
relations.quote: I am Syr Vondam of the Sunstar Free Company.

relations.note: Slats is captain of the Dawnsire.
relations.quote: My name is Slats. I'm the captain of this instrument, and the coronal of the faithful aboard.

relations.note: Alpharael identifies Slats as an Astelli.

relations.quote: You struck dead a man who was my friend.

relations.note: Monoist disciples are disciples of the Faller.
relations.quote: The disciples of HIM WHO FALLS have prepared.
